incident_text: A brick building partly collapsed after the earthquake. Bricks are lying across the street.

result.scene_summary: A damaged brick building with significant structural damage and rubble on the street corner, with traffic lights and other buildings in the background.

observations.description: A multi-story brick building with collapsed sections, exposed wooden framing, and missing walls.
A traffic light pole and a traffic light are visible at the corner of the street.
A pile of bricks and debris on the street with an orange traffic cone.
A red vehicle is parked on the street in the background.
Trees are visible in the background, behind other buildings.
